instructions.name: cancel_unshield
docs: Unfreeze an account whose move to wallet stopped before step 2.

instructions.name: collect_lp_fees
docs: Pay an LP holder their share of the swap fees since the last payout
(anyone may send it; the fees always go to the holder).

accounts.name: lp_eta
docs: Only read: its ciphertext goes to Arcium as is.

instructions.name: create_order_book
docs: Open a private TOKEN/USDC order book. Token creator only.

instructions.name: create_pool
docs: Create a token/USDC pool and its LP token. Creator only.

instructions.name: create_token
docs: Create a token: real SPL mint with metadata, SPL supply 0.

instructions.name: finish_unshield
docs: Move to wallet, step 3: Arcium subtracts the amount and unfreezes the account.

instructions.name: init_book_place_comp_def
docs: One-time setup: register the `book_place` MPC circuit.

instructions.name: init_book_settle_comp_def
docs: One-time setup: register the `book_settle` MPC circuit.

instructions.name: init_commit_balance_comp_def
docs: One-time setup: register the `commit_balance` MPC circuit.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: One-time setup: config + fake USDC mint.

instructions.name: init_credit_balance_comp_def
docs: One-time setup: register the `credit_balance` MPC circuit.

instructions.name: init_debit_balance_comp_def
docs: One-time setup: register the `debit_balance` MPC circuit.

instructions.name: init_lp_collect_comp_def
docs: One-time setup: register the `lp_collect` MPC circuit.

instructions.name: init_pool_swap_comp_def
docs: One-time setup: register the `pool_swap` MPC circuit.

instructions.name: init_seed_pool_comp_def
docs: One-time setup: register the `seed_pool` MPC circuit.

instructions.name: mint_private
docs: Mint fake USDC (anyone) or your own token (creator) into your encrypted account.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: toward the max supply too).

instructions.name: open_account
docs: Open an empty encrypted account for a token (needed before a first swap).

instructions.name: open_lp_position
docs: Open the record that tracks one holder's share of a pool's swap fees (anyone).

instructions.name: open_vault
docs: Open the program's vault (token account) for a mint (anyone).

instructions.name: place_order
docs: Place an order (`kind`: 0 limit, 1 market, 2 post-only); side, price and
size are encrypted in the browser.

accounts.name: usdc_eta
docs: Must exist (see `open_account`).

accounts.name: token_eta
docs: Must exist (see `open_account`).

instructions.name: prepare_unshield
docs: Move to wallet, step 1: Arcium fingerprints the balance and freezes the account.

accounts.name: token_creator
docs: LP token, which stays private: its fees are paid to LP positions.

instructions.name: register_external_token
docs: List an SPL token this exchange didn't create, so it can be moved in (anyone).

accounts.name: token_info
docs: Exchange-created mints already have one, so this only works for outside mints.

instructions.name: register_user
docs: Store the caller's x25519 encryption key.

instructions.name: seed_pool
docs: Add the creator's initial liquidity privately (encrypted amounts).

accounts.name: pool
docs: Creator + status checked in the handler (stack limit).

accounts.name: token_info
docs: Checked in the handler (stack limit).

accounts.name: token_eta
docs: Ownership checked in the handler (stack limit).

accounts.name: usdc_eta
docs: Ownership checked in the handler (stack limit).

accounts.name: lp_eta
docs: Must exist (see `open_account`).
Ownership checked in the handler (stack limit).

instructions.name: settle_order
docs: Settle a traded order into its owner's balances (anyone); `cancel` also
returns what is still locked (owner only).

instructions.name: shield
docs: Move public SPL tokens from your wallet into your private balance.

accounts.name: token_creator
docs: LP token, which stays private.

accounts.name: eta
docs: Must exist (see `open_account`).

instructions.name: swap
docs: Buy or sell privately (encrypted amount + slippage limit).

accounts.name: usdc_eta
docs: Must exist (see `open_account`).

accounts.name: token_eta
docs: Must exist (see `open_account`).

instructions.name: unshield
docs: Move to wallet, step 2: verify the ZK proof and send real SPL tokens
(from the vault first, minting the rest only for exchange-made tokens).

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any token account of the owner for this mint (clients use the ATA).

types.name: BookPlaceOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: BookSettleOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: ClockAccount
docs: An account storing the current network epoch

types.name: CommitBalanceOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: ComputationDefinitionAccount
docs: An account representing a [ComputationDefinition] in a MXE.

types.name: ComputationDefinitionMeta
docs: A computation definition for execution in a MXE.

types.name: ComputationSignature
docs: The signature of a computation defined in a [ComputationDefinition].

types.name: Config
docs: Global exchange settings. PDA("config").

types.name: CreditBalanceOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: DebitBalanceOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: EncryptedTokenAccount
docs: Encrypted Token Account: one per (owner, mint). PDA("eta", owner, mint).
The balance is a Rescue ciphertext readable by the owner (with their x25519 key)
and by the Arcium MPC cluster. Only MPC callbacks ever write it.

fields.name: balance_ct
docs: Encrypted u64 balance. Kept as the first field so its byte offset stays fixed.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Nonce `balance_ct` was encrypted with. New on every update.

fields.name: enc_pubkey
docs: x25519 key the balance is encrypted to.

fields.name: is_initialized
docs: False until the first MPC write; until then the balance is zero.

fields.name: pending_computation
docs: Computation account of the in-flight MPC job, default when idle.

fields.name: pending_amount
docs: Public amount the in-flight job adds to the supply on success.

fields.name: unshield_commitment
docs: SHA3-256(balance ‖ salt), published by Arcium. The ZK proof opens it.

fields.name: unshield_salt_ct
docs: The salt, encrypted to the owner.

fields.name: unshield_amount
docs: Amount already minted to the wallet and waiting to be debited.

fields.name: credit_kind
docs: What the pending credit is: faucet / creator mint, or a shield deposit.

fields.name: shield_owed
docs: Tokens already moved into the vault by `shield` but not yet credited
(credited by the MPC callback; re-sent if that job fails).

types.name: Epoch
docs: The network epoch

types.name: Groth16Proof
docs: A Groth16 proof in the syscalls' (EIP-197) encoding: big-endian field
elements, G2 as x.c1 ‖ x.c0 ‖ y.c1 ‖ y.c0.

types.name: LeaderChoice
docs: The computation chosen by a node to be executed when the node is leader.

types.name: LeaderInfo
docs: The information about a node.

types.name: LeaderSelector
docs: To select a Leader.
Uses the greatest divisors method: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D%27Hondt_method

types.name: LpCollectOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: LpFeesPaid
docs: An LP holder was paid their share of the swap fees (amounts encrypted to them).

types.name: LpPosition
docs: One LP holder's fee position in one pool. PDA("lp_fees", pool, owner).
`checkpoint` is the pool's fee growth at the last payout (encrypted to the
cluster); `earned` is the holder's lifetime LP fees, encrypted to them.

fields.name: checkpoint_ct
docs: First two fields, so their offsets (8 and 40) are fixed for the MPC job.

fields.name: paid_swap_count
docs: The pool's trade count covered by the last payout (public).

fields.name: pending_swap_count
docs: The pool's trade count when the pending payout was queued.

types.name: MXEAccount
docs: A MPC Execution Environment.

types.name: MxeStatus
docs: The status of an MXE.

types.name: NodeMetadata
docs: location as [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html) country code

types.name: NodeRef
docs: A reference to a node in the cluster.
The offset is to derive the Node Account.

types.name: OrderBook
docs: A private order book: one token against USDC. PDA("book", token_mint).
Every order's side, price, size and fills live in one ciphertext that only
Arcium can read. Public: which slots hold an order, whose, and in what order
they arrived.

fields.name: book_ct
docs: All slots, packed and encrypted to Arcium. First field, so its offset is fixed.

fields.name: initialized
docs: False until the first order: before that the book is empty.

fields.name: owners
docs: Owner of each slot (default key = free).

fields.name: seqs
docs: Order number of each slot (0 = free). Lower = older = first in line.

fields.name: settle_mask
docs: Slots that traded and wait for settlement (one bit per slot).

fields.name: last_price
docs: Last trade price (micro-USDC per token) and time: public, like on any exchange.

fields.name: trades
docs: Orders that traded on arrival.

types.name: OrderPlaced
docs: A new order was matched. Public: whether it now waits in the book, which
resting orders it traded with (one bit per slot) and its last trade price
(0 = no trade). Never its side or size.

types.name: OrderRejected
docs: An order was refused (not enough balance, or a zero price / size).

types.name: OrderSettled
docs: An order's fills were settled into its owner's balances. `done`: it left
the book (fully filled, or `cancelled`).

types.name: OrderViews
docs: Each owner's copy of their order, encrypted to them, as of their last
action (place / collect). PDA("book_views", book). Kept apart from the book
so placing an order stays within Solana's stack limit.

types.name: Output
docs: An output of a computation.
We currently don't support encrypted outputs yet since encrypted values are passed via
data objects.

types.name: Parameter
docs: A parameter of a computation.
We differentiate between plaintext and encrypted parameters and data objects.
Plaintext parameters are directly provided as their value.
Encrypted parameters are provided as an offchain reference to the data.
Data objects are provided as a reference to the data object account.

types.name: Pool
docs: A token/USDC constant-product pool. PDA("pool", token_mint).
Reserves are encrypted to the Arcium cluster only. Price and a coarse health
score are public; Arcium sets both after every seed and swap.

fields.name: reserves_ct
docs: Encrypted {token, usdc} reserves. First field, so its byte offset is fixed at 8.

fields.name: price
docs: USDC per whole token, scaled by 1e12.

fields.name: health
docs: Coarse 0–100 health score.

fields.name: price_history
docs: Ring buffer of recent public prices, oldest overwritten first.

fields.name: pending_computation
docs: Computation account of the in-flight MPC job, default when idle.

fields.name: pending_kind
docs: What the in-flight job is: 0 = seed, 1 = buy, 2 = sell, 3 = fee payout.

fields.name: fee_growth_ct
docs: Swap fees owed to LP holders, per LP unit (× 2^40), encrypted to the
cluster. False until the first trade that pays a fee.

types.name: PoolSwapOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: PoolUpdated
docs: Emitted when a seed or swap finishes. Price and health are public; amounts are not.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = seed, 1 = buy, 2 = sell.

types.name: SeedPoolOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: SetUnset
docs: Utility struct to store a value that needs to be set by a certain number of participants (keys
in our case). Once all participants have set the value, the value is considered set and we only
store it once.

types.name: Shielded
docs: Public tokens moved into the vault; the owner's private balance is credited by Arcium.

types.name: TokenInfo
docs: Public facts about an exchange token. PDA("token", mint).
Exchange-created mints start with SPL supply 0. Tokens live inside encrypted
token accounts, and `exchange_supply` is their public total. Public tokens can
come back in via the vault (`shield`).

fields.name: exchange_supply
docs: Tokens inside the exchange (public number): all private balances, plus
shield deposits whose credit is still on its way.

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Cap on the circulating supply (see `circulating`). `u64::MAX` for fake
USDC, 0 for outside tokens (never minted here).

fields.name: is_external
docs: A mint this program did not create: it is never minted, only held in the vault.

fields.name: vault_amount
docs: Public tokens deposited into this program's vault by `shield`.

types.name: UnshieldDebited
docs: The encrypted balance was reduced by the unshielded amount.

types.name: UnshieldReady
docs: Arcium published a fingerprint of the balance; the owner can now prove.

types.name: Unshielded
docs: A ZK proof was accepted and `amount` real SPL tokens were minted to the wallet.

types.name: UserAccount
docs: A registered user. PDA("user", wallet).

fields.name: enc_pubkey
docs: x25519 public key derived from the user's wallet signature.
Every balance of this user is encrypted to it (Arcium "Shared" mode).

constants.name: INITIAL_LP_SUPPLY
docs: LP minted to the creator when a pool is seeded: 1,000,000 LP (6 decimals).
Fixed on purpose — a √(token·usdc) supply would reveal the reserves.

constants.name: MAX_MINT_PER_CALL
docs: Largest single mint request: 1 billion whole tokens (6 decimals).

constants.name: MAX_ORDERS_PER_USER
docs: Open orders one wallet may have in one book, so nobody can fill it alone.

constants.name: MIN_FEE_BPS
docs: Pool fee limits in basis points: 0.10% – 10%.

constants.name: ORDER_LIMIT
docs: Order types (must match the circuits).

constants.name: ORDER_MARKET
docs: Fills now at the best prices up to its limit; the rest is returned.

constants.name: ORDER_POST_ONLY
docs: Only waits in the book; refused if it would trade immediately.

constants.name: TOKEN_DECIMALS
docs: Every exchange token uses 6 decimals, like USDC, to keep pool and order math simple.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: Token account (one per mint) holding public tokens moved into the exchange.
